results.description: Use fnd91_sentiment2_0 (high coverage/userCount) to capture recent increases in positive dictionary-based words. I applied SUGGESTION1 partially (single strong field) because fnd91_sentiment2_0 has high userCount and coverage, so signal is robust. SUGGESTION2 not applicable (no vector field). SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage 0.8664). SUGGESTION4 applied by choosing a high userCount field. Kept implementation short per KEEP_IN_MINDs. Confidence: 0.78.

Higher readability (easier language) may indicate clearer disclosures and positive market reaction. I used fnd91_readability_0 (high coverage/userCount). SUGGESTION1: single reliable field chosen to maximize signal quality. SUGGESTION3 skipped since coverage high. Implementation concise per KEEP_IN_MIND. Confidence: 0.65.

Combine sentiment and readability: positive sentiment rising while readability worsens may signal obfuscation + selective optimism. I used fnd91_sentiment2_0 and fnd91_readability_0 (both high coverage). Applied SUGGESTION1 to combine two fields; SUGGESTION3 not needed. Kept operators <=7 and fields=2. Confidence: 0.72.

Spike in negative dictionary words (fnd91_sentiment2_1) may forecast mean-reversion bounce (overreaction). Used fnd91_sentiment2_1 (coverage 0.8664). SUGGESTION1: single focused field with high userCount. No ts_backfill needed. Confidence: 0.60.
Rising exposure to fnd91_topic_4 (high user/alphaCount) can signal newsworthy themes. SUGGESTION1 used to select topic with many alphas (robust). Coverage 0.7101 so no backfill. Confidence: 0.66.

results.idea: Topic-readability cross: complex topic + low readability
results.description: Combine fnd91_topic_4 and fnd91_readability_0: high topic exposure with low readability may indicate opaque important events. Applied SUGGESTION1 (2 fields). Both coverages >0.6 so no backfill. Implementation limited length. Confidence: 0.69.
Large number of attached documents (fnd91_doccount) may indicate substantive disclosures. Chosen for coverage 0.6578. SUGGESTION1 single field due to directness. Confidence: 0.55.
High fnd91_numeric_count suggests detailed quantitative disclosures that may be priced. Field has high coverage/userCount. SUGGESTION1 single strong field. Confidence: 0.63.
Increase in fnd91_measure_2 (complex words) may signal obfuscation or regulatory detail; tested as persistence via ts_zscore. SUGGESTION1 used single measure with high coverage. Confidence: 0.54.

Compare two sentiment models (fnd91_sentiment1_4 vs fnd91_sentiment1_6). If model2 is more negative relative to model1, it may capture nuances. I applied SUGGESTION1 to use two complementary fields with solid coverage. SUGGESTION4 favored higher userCount fields. Confidence: 0.68.
Momentum in fnd91_topic_13 (high coverage and several alphas) signals increasing thematic relevance. Used ts_zscore of ts_delta. SUGGESTION1 chosen topic with many alphas. Confidence: 0.7.

Rising positive sentiment with improving readability (both high coverage) is a stronger bullish signal than either alone. Combined fnd91_sentiment1_6 and fnd91_readability_0 per SUGGESTION1. Confidence: 0.74.
Use fnd91_topic_18 (many user/alphaCount) to detect sudden theme attention. Coverage 0.668 so stable. SUGGESTION1 used. Confidence: 0.67.
Persistent negative sentiment measured by fnd91_sentiment1_2 over 5 filings (ts_mean) may predict longer-term weakness. SUGGESTION1 used single robust field. Confidence: 0.62.
High ts_std_dev of fnd91_readability_0 implies inconsistent messaging — risk signal. Chosen high-coverage field; SUGGESTION1 applied. Confidence: 0.56.

Count of distinct topic exposures rising (use two prominent topics fnd91_topic_4 and fnd91_topic_13). SUGGESTION1 used to combine two topic exposures as proxy for breadth. Coverage >0.6 so no backfill. Confidence: 0.64.
Change in fnd91_measure_0 (sentence count) signals disclosure volume surprise. Selected due to high coverage/userCount. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Confidence: 0.58.
High complex words (fnd91_measure_2) but low numeric_count could indicate narrative spin. Applied SUGGESTION1 combining two fields with good coverage. Confidence: 0.60.
If topic exposure rises while readability drops sharply, expect mean reversion. Used fnd91_topic_4 and fnd91_readability_0; both have decent coverage. SUGGESTION1 applied. Confidence: 0.61.
ts_arg_max on fnd91_sentiment1_5 (negative model #2) flags the day of max negativity; trade contrarian next day. SUGGESTION1: single targeted field with userCount=2. Confidence: 0.57.
fnd91_topic_10 uptick may indicate specific event exposure (coverage 0.8007). SUGGESTION1 chosen topic with solid coverage/userCount. Confidence: 0.63.

Compare fnd91_sentiment2_0 (dictionary positive) with fnd91_sentiment1_4 (model positive). Divergence may reveal model-specific bias. Applied SUGGESTION1. Confidence: 0.66.
Rising fnd91_topic_12 exposure (coverage 0.8487) signals growing thematic relevance. SUGGESTION1 used single high-quality topic. Confidence: 0.68.
High combined exposure to fnd91_topic_12 and fnd91_topic_13 indicates concentration on related issues. Used SUGGESTION1 to combine two topics. Confidence: 0.65.
Normalize fnd91_sentiment2_0 across universe (zscore) to get cross-sectional signal. SUGGESTION1 used single strong field; quantile/zscore operators keep implementation short. Confidence: 0.72.
Sharp drop in fnd91_readability_2 (alternate model) may indicate obfuscation; used ts_max_diff to capture decline relative to recent max. SUGGESTION1 applied. Confidence: 0.59.
Monitor fnd91_topic_7 (coverage 0.8597) upticks as theme signals. SUGGESTION1 selected high-coverage topic. Confidence: 0.64.

Apply ts_decay_linear on fnd91_sentiment2_0 to emphasize recent sentiment with controlled turnover. SUGGESTION1 single field used; hump/decay helps turnover control per KEEP_IN_MIND. Confidence: 0.71.
High fnd91_measure_2 (complex words) with improving readability suggests targeted complexity; combined per SUGGESTION1. Confidence: 0.52.

Average momentum of two sentiment fields (fnd91_sentiment1_6 and fnd91_sentiment2_0) to reduce model-specific noise. SUGGESTION1 combined two high-quality fields; applied ts_zscore for robustness. Confidence: 0.75.
If topic exposure fnd91_topic_4 rises while fnd91_sentiment2_1 (negative) spikes, prefer short. SUGGESTION1 used two fields to form a directional signal. Confidence: 0.7.

Compare current readability to same quarter last year using ts_delta with lag window (ts_delta with d=252 not allowed here), approximated by ts_delta 4 filings via ts_delta and ts_mean. Kept simple due to operator limits. Confidence: 0.50.
Use fnd91_topic_2 (coverage 0.8358) rising exposure coupled with improved readability as bullish. SUGGESTION1 in combining topic and readability. Confidence: 0.62.
Average zscore across two sentiment models fnd91_sentiment1_6 and fnd91_sentiment1_9 for consensus signal. SUGGESTION1 applied and fields have reasonable coverage. Confidence: 0.73.
Detect uptick in fnd91_topic_14 (coverage 0.7458) via ts_arg_max to find days of highest recent exposure for trading the theme. SUGGESTION1 applied. Confidence: 0.61.
High sentence count (fnd91_measure_0) with low numeric_count may indicate verbose narrative vs substance; combined per SUGGESTION1. Confidence: 0.55.
Monitor sustained rise in fnd91_topic_16 via ts_mean over window; SUGGESTION1 used single topic. Confidence: 0.60.
If fnd91_sentiment1_4 (positive) and fnd91_sentiment1_5 (negative) move in same direction, that’s weak signal; flag divergence by subtracting. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence: 0.58.
Use ts_arg_max on fnd91_topic_11 to detect breakout day of maximal exposure for quick trade. Coverage 0.7238. SUGGESTION1 applied. Confidence: 0.59.

Use kth_element backfill for lower-coverage sentiment when needed. For high-coverage fnd91_sentiment1_6, use ts_delta 1. SUGGESTION3 considered but not applied (coverage high). Confidence: 0.68.
Weight sentiment by topic exposure: high topic_4 * sentiment2_0 may amplify relevant sentiment. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence: 0.73.

Monitor ts_rank of fnd91_topic_8 to detect relative prominence within recent window. SUGGESTION1 applied. Confidence: 0.58.

Add two topics fnd91_topic_12 and fnd91_topic_13 to detect correlated thematic emphasis. SUGGESTION1 used two fields; both have good alphaCount. Confidence: 0.66.

Detect ts_delta spike in fnd91_topic_5 to capture niche theme events. SUGGESTION1 applied; coverage 0.6646. Confidence: 0.52.

Divide readability by complexity metric fnd91_sentiment2_3 to detect clarity per complexity. SUGGESTION1 used two fields; if complexity coverage <0.6 would backfill but it's 0.8658 so not needed. Confidence: 0.60.
Combine ts_mean(fnd91_topic_6) with ts_delta to filter noisy blips; usage kept short per KEEP_IN_MIND. SUGGESTION1 used single topic. Confidence: 0.55.

Use ts_mean of fnd91_topic_1 to detect gradual buildup in exposure. Coverage 0.5741 (below 0.6) so per SUGGESTION3 we would backfill; applied ts_backfill to avoid sparse series. Confidence: 0.49.
Use ts_max_diff of fnd91_sentiment2_0 to measure drop from recent max (fear spikes), trade contrarian. SUGGESTION1 single robust field. Confidence: 0.67.
